blurb: We are a Martial Arts school serving Bremerton and Kitsap County, Washington USA. We offer classes in Filipino Martial Arts, Jeet Kune Do, Silat, Muay Thai, Kickboxing, Boxing, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Submission Grappling, and MMA for ages 8 and up. Whether you train for fitness, self-defense, or sports competition, we have the right program(s) just for you!
